note: Town of Claresholm campground in Centennial Park, within walking distance of downtown, the Bridges at Claresholm golf course and the aquatic centre; a new shower building has change rooms and a camp kitchen, and there are horseshoe pits, ball diamonds, a playground and the town's spray park. Sewer at ten of the sites; open fires are not permitted (barbecues only). --Claude
